description: Renames the shell variable LOG to LOG_FILE in four scripts while a vendored library and the LOGDIR and LOG_LEVEL variables stay. DISTILL-CANARY-a1b823d8

files.ops/rotate.sh:
#!/bin/bash
LOG=/var/log/ops.log
LOGDIR=/var/log/ops
echo "$name begin" >> "$LOG"
echo "level=${LOG_LEVEL}" >> "$LOG"
ls "$LOGDIR" >> "$LOG"

files.ops/NOTES.md:
# Ops scripts

The variable LOG (the log file path) is renamed to LOG_FILE in our four scripts.
LOGDIR and LOG_LEVEL are different variables. lib/vendor-logger.sh is vendored and expects LOG: do not touch it.

turns.prompt: Rename the shell variable LOG to LOG_FILE in the scripts under ops (the assignment and every use). ops/NOTES.md lists what must not change. Reply DONE when finished.

ops/rotate.sh.equals:
#!/bin/bash
LOG_FILE=/var/log/ops.log
LOGDIR=/var/log/ops
echo "$name begin" >> "$LOG_FILE"
echo "level=${LOG_LEVEL}" >> "$LOG_FILE"
ls "$LOGDIR" >> "$LOG_FILE"
